edit.description: the order declared on the chain

summary: the package declares order: goal work first in the goals' order with everything it is blockedBy, then the longest dependent chain, then oldest filing, then tag
acceptance: the package's order serves work under the first-ranked goal before work under the second, carries each goal's blockedBy upstream with it, then ranks the rest by the longest chain of work waiting behind each, then by filing, then by tag — and returns a permutation of what it was handed
tests: work under the first-ranked goal is served before work under the second
everything a goal's work is blockedBy is served with that goal's work
work under no goal is served behind every goal's work
among ungoaled work the longest dependent chain is served first
equal dependent chains break on oldest filing, then tag
where an entry came from never orders it
pins: the package's order returns a permutation of the entries it was handed
notes: The longest-dependent-chain key is critical-path list scheduling over the blockedBy graph the context carries; the graph is the engine's, so the order walks it rather than re-resolving it.
